seed: A copied clip pastes at the playhead, the way Premiere pastes it. At Next defaults, no flag set: the recording is picked and copied with Cmd-C (Edit, Copy: a walk cannot press a menu chord in a background app, so it runs the same command), the playhead goes to 0:05 and Cmd-V lays the copy in starting there. V1 is busy at 0:05, so it lands on a new V2 straight over it, its own sound linked under the recording's; nothing already cut moves. The playhead waits at the copy's end, so a second Cmd-V lays the next copy straight after it, on V1 where V1 is free. One undo takes a paste back.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: Cmd-V with the playhead at 0:05 lays the copy in from 0:05 to 0:13. V1 is busy there, so it lands on a new V2 straight over the recording, covering nothing, its own sound linked on a new Audio 2. The copy is picked and the playhead waits at its end
THE SECOND TEST: Cmd-V again lays the next copy straight after the first, at the playhead, 0:13 to 0:21, on V1 where V1 is free: not stepped across the canvas, not back at 0:00
THE THIRD TEST: one undo takes each paste back, the second paste first; after two the timeline is the recording alone again
